name: ticketarr
description: Watches an email inbox for AMC A-List and Regal Unlimited movie ticket confirmations, resolves the movie on TMDB, then scrobbles it to your tracker (Trakt, Ryot, or Yamtrack) with the correct showtime and (optionally) requests it in Jellyseerr/Overseerr or Ombi. Headless - no WebUI, only a private /healthz endpoint for Docker healthchecks.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: Persistent state (state.json), cached Trakt OAuth token, and optional config.yml. On first run ticketarr drops a `config.yml.sample` here - copy it to `config.yml` if you'd rather configure via YAML than environment variables. Must be writable by the container.

ports.name: Healthcheck
ports.description: Private HTTP port that serves /healthz for Docker/Unraid healthchecks. Only exposed to the Docker network; no WebUI is served here.

variables.name: IMAP_HOST
variables.description: IMAP server hostname (e.g. imap.gmail.com, outlook.office365.com). Required unless set in /config/config.yml.

variables.name: IMAP_PORT
variables.description: IMAP TLS port. Defaults to 993 (implicit TLS).

variables.name: IMAP_USERNAME
variables.description: IMAP account username (usually your email address). Required unless set in /config/config.yml.

variables.name: IMAP_PASSWORD
variables.description: IMAP account password. For Gmail/Google Workspace you MUST use an App Password, not your real password. Required unless set in /config/config.yml.

variables.name: IMAP_MAILBOX
variables.description: Mailbox to poll.

variables.name: IMAP_SSL
variables.description: Use implicit TLS on the IMAP connection.

variables.name: IMAP_SENDER_FILTERS
variables.description: Comma-separated list of From-addresses to poll. Leave empty to use every registered parser's default senders (AMC + Regal). Set to override, e.g. to add a friend who forwards you tickets.

variables.name: IMAP_INITIAL_LOOKBACK_DAYS
variables.description: On first run, skip messages older than this many days. 0 = process every message in the inbox.

variables.name: IMAP_POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS
variables.description: Fallback polling interval when the server doesn't support IMAP IDLE.

variables.name: IMAP_MARK_SEEN
variables.description: Mark processed messages as seen. Set false if you want them to stay unread.

variables.name: TMDB_API_KEY
variables.description: TMDB v3 API key. Free - request at https://www.themoviedb.org/settings/api. Either this OR TMDB_BEARER_TOKEN is required (or set one of them in /config/config.yml).

variables.name: TMDB_BEARER_TOKEN
variables.description: TMDB v4 read access token (Bearer). Optional alternative to TMDB_API_KEY.

variables.name: TRACKER_PROVIDER
variables.description: Which watch tracker to scrobble to. One of: none, trakt, ryot, yamtrack. Leave blank to inherit the value from /config/config.yml (defaults to `none` when unset). See the matching credential variables below.

variables.name: REQUESTER_PROVIDER
variables.description: Where to request the movie so it's available in your library. One of: none, seerr, ombi. Leave blank to inherit from /config/config.yml.

variables.name: TRAKT_CLIENT_ID
variables.description: Trakt application Client ID. Create a free app at https://trakt.tv/oauth/applications - Redirect URI must be `urn:ietf:wg:oauth:2.0:oob`. Required only when TRACKER_PROVIDER=trakt.

variables.name: TRAKT_CLIENT_SECRET
variables.description: Trakt application Client Secret. Required only when TRACKER_PROVIDER=trakt.

variables.name: RYOT_BASE_URL
variables.description: Base URL of your Ryot instance (e.g. http://ryot:8000). Required only when TRACKER_PROVIDER=ryot, and only if not set in /config/config.yml.

variables.name: RYOT_USERNAME
variables.description: Ryot username. ticketarr logs in via the loginUser GraphQL mutation at startup and uses the returned session token for all subsequent calls. Required only when TRACKER_PROVIDER=ryot (unless RYOT_API_KEY is set instead).

variables.name: RYOT_PASSWORD
variables.description: Ryot password. Required only when TRACKER_PROVIDER=ryot (unless RYOT_API_KEY is set instead).

variables.name: RYOT_API_KEY
variables.description: Advanced fallback: a pre-issued Ryot session token (e.g. from a processAccessLink access link). Use instead of RYOT_USERNAME/RYOT_PASSWORD. Most users should leave this blank.

variables.name: YAMTRACK_BASE_URL
variables.description: Base URL of your Yamtrack instance (e.g. http://yamtrack:8000). Required only when TRACKER_PROVIDER=yamtrack, and only if not set in /config/config.yml.

variables.name: YAMTRACK_USERNAME
variables.description: Yamtrack web-UI username. ticketarr drives Yamtrack's internal /media_save form (no REST API supports backdated watched-at). Required only when TRACKER_PROVIDER=yamtrack.

variables.name: YAMTRACK_PASSWORD
variables.description: Yamtrack web-UI password. Required only when TRACKER_PROVIDER=yamtrack.

variables.name: SEERR_BASE_URL
variables.description: Base URL of your Jellyseerr or Overseerr instance (e.g. http://jellyseerr:5055). Required only when REQUESTER_PROVIDER=seerr, and only if not set in /config/config.yml.

variables.name: SEERR_API_KEY
variables.description: Jellyseerr/Overseerr API key. Required only when REQUESTER_PROVIDER=seerr.

variables.name: SEERR_REQUEST_4K
variables.description: Set true to file 4K requests instead of standard quality.

variables.name: OMBI_BASE_URL
variables.description: Base URL of your Ombi instance (e.g. http://ombi:3579). Required only when REQUESTER_PROVIDER=ombi, and only if not set in /config/config.yml.

variables.name: OMBI_API_KEY
variables.description: Ombi API key. Required only when REQUESTER_PROVIDER=ombi.

variables.name: OMBI_LANGUAGE_CODE
variables.description: ISO 639-1 language code sent with Ombi requests.

variables.name: TICKETARR_LOG_LEVEL
variables.description: Python logging level (DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR).
